audience: shop and venue owners who sell gift cards with Gift Up!

useCases.title: Summarize gift card sales for a period
useCases.text: The AI lists orders filtered by creation time, source or purchaser email, with revenue, tip, fees and discount, and adds them up for the period.

useCases.title: Find gift cards that still have a balance
useCases.text: The AI lists gift cards by state, order, recipient or purchaser email, with balance, expiry and status flags such as expired or voided. Codes are masked.

useCases.title: Check one gift card and its history
useCases.text: The AI opens one gift card by its code and shows its balance, expiry, recipient and the ledger of events, such as created, redeemed or topped up. It never redeems the card.

useCases.title: Review the promotions running at checkout
useCases.text: The AI lists promotions with their benefits, dates, usage counts, revenue and triggers such as promo code or spend threshold.

useCases.title: Audit the transaction log by event or location
useCases.text: The AI reads the financial transactions, such as OrderPlaced, Redeemed, Expired or Voided, filtered by time range, event type, user or location.
